_README: figma2css - design tokens config. Copy this file to `tokens.config.json` in your theme repo (alongside your CSS source dir) and adjust the values below. Every field except `output` is optional; the values shown here are the built-in defaults, so leaving them as-is changes nothing. See this repo's README for the full schema including `managed_region` and `scope_units` overrides.
_source_json: Optional, default ~/Downloads. Where the Raw Token Exporter plugin's Download JSON button saves the export (<figma-file-slug>-tokens.json). A directory (the skill reads the newest *-tokens.json in it) or a specific file path; ~ and $HOME expand. At step 2 the skill asks 'downloaded file or clipboard'; when you pick the file, it reads from this location.
_skip_collections: Optional. Array of collection names (exact match) to exclude from the emission - e.g. ["Utility (do not export)"]. The export skill auto-detects '(do not export)'-style markers in collection names and asks before adding them here; once recorded, re-exports skip silently. The transformer warns when an exported variable aliases into a skipped collection (the emitted var() would never resolve).
_text_styles_output: Optional. When set, TextStyle typography moves OUT of the tokens file into this path (e.g. "css/base/typography.css", or "scss/base/typography.scss" on a Sass theme; "scss/base/_typography.scss" partial when text_styles_format is scss-mixins). The skill then runs the transformer twice - `--emit tokens` and `--emit text-styles` - and splices each into its target's managed region. Unset = legacy combined emission into the tokens file.
_text_styles_format: Optional, default "css-classes". How TextStyles are emitted: "css-classes" (.name { … }), "scss-mixins" (@mixin name { … } - Sass themes; components @include them), or "both" (mixin + a class that @includes it). On Sass themes the export skill asks which you want the first time and records the answer here.
_text_styles_consumption: Optional; only meaningful when text_styles_format is "both". How downstream component tooling consumes the styles: "classes" (default - compose the utility class in Twig) or "mixins" (@include in each component's .scss). Forced by the format otherwise (css-classes → classes, scss-mixins → mixins). Asked once at export time; never mixed within a project.
_foundations: Optional, recorded by the export skill's step 4b (references/foundations.md), never set by hand up front. Per-piece status of the theme layout-foundations scaffold, shaped {"breakpoints": "scaffolded"|"declined"|"preexisting", "grid": ..., "spacing": ..., "breakpoints_yml": ...}. "preexisting" = found in the theme's code and left alone; "scaffolded" = created by the skill, owned by the project afterwards; "declined" = the user said no. Any recorded status silences the question, so re-exports only re-ask for pieces still missing in code AND unrecorded here.
_icons_dir: Optional, used by downstream component tooling. Theme-relative directory where icon SVGs land (e.g. "assets/icons" or "images/icons"; never under templates/).
_text_styles_responsive: Optional. When a text style binds a property (font-size etc.) to a variable in a TWO-MODE collection whose mode names carry viewport anchors (e.g. "Max (1440px)" / "Min (375px)") and the values differ between modes, emit it responsively. {"strategy": "stepped", "switch": "48em"} = mobile-first small-viewport var() plus an @media (width >= switch) override of the same property (em or px only; rem is rejected because @media resolves rem against the browser 16px default, not the theme root). {"strategy": "fluid"} = a self-contained clamp() interpolating between the two anchors (requires the (Npx) anchors in both mode names). Unset = current behavior: only the default mode's var() is referenced. Properties whose bound variable is identical across modes always emit a single declaration. Works in plain CSS, Sass, and PostCSS output (plain-CSS class output collects stepped overrides into one trailing @media block).
